summary: Initial release of PlainDental — dental health education in plain language with interactive tooth map, premium content, and NutriSize-inspired dark theme.
included: 16 dental conditions with detailed causes, symptoms, treatment, and prevention
12 dental procedures with step-by-step guides, cost ranges, and recovery info
Interactive tooth map with full 32-tooth diagram and realistic tooth shape visualization
Dental emergency guide with immediate steps and severity indicators
Kids dental health guides by age range
Dental cost guide with national averages and insurance coverage info
Pre-visit preparation guides with questions to ask your dentist
Premium content with one-time in-app purchase ($4.99)
StoreKit 2 (iOS) and Google Play Billing v7 (Android) integration
Dark theme with NutriSize-inspired design system
Performance optimized: cached filtering, O(1) lookups, lazy loading
